configure_cache_size_limit: configure the maximum number of cache entries for TorchDynamo optimization
set_suppress_errors_flag: set TorchDynamo to suppress errors and fallback to eager mode on compilation failure
enable_ddp_optimization: enable automatic DDP bucket optimization for comm/compute overlap in distributed training
check_fbcode_environment: check whether the current PyTorch build is from internal fbcode rather than OSS
configure_debug_dir: configure the debug output directory for TorchDynamo compilation artifacts
